ruleDefinitions.name: Wscript Shell Run In CommandLine
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the presence of the keywords "Wscript", "Shell" and "Run" in the command, which could indicate a suspicious activity

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*Wscript\\\..*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.Shell.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.Run.*"))
